items.title: Is Southern (SO) Fairly Valued As It Files For 5,000,000 New Shares?
items.summary: Southern (SO) has put fresh equity in focus after filing a US$467.85 million shelf registration for 5,000,000 common shares tied to an employee stock ownership plan related offering. Southern’s latest share offering lands after a strong run in the background, with the stock at US$92.47 and a roughly 6.1% year to date share price gain. items.title: What Does Southern (SO) $1.75 Billion Equity Units Offering Mean For Investors?
items.summary: Southern Company (NYSE:SO) launched a public offering of equity units totaling US$1.75b. The utility plans to use the capital to repurchase existing convertible debt and repay short term borrowings. Remaining proceeds are earmarked for general corporate purposes, affecting how Southern Company structures its financing mix.
